Name: CS_MOTION_BLUR_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Motion blur settings for each level of the Motion Blur option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The first 5 rows in file order are the levels Off, Low, Medium, High and Maximum; row IDs are ignored and further rows are not read. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 2.

Fields.Name: Motion Blur Enabled
Fields.Description: Turns motion blur on for this level. Retail: off only on the Off row.

Fields.Name: Object Motion Blur Enabled
Fields.Description: Lets moving objects blur, not only camera motion. Retail: off on Off and Low.

Fields.Name: Lower-Resolution Velocity Buffer
Fields.Description: On: the velocity buffer used for the blur is drawn at reduced resolution. Retail: on up to High, off on Maximum.

Fields.Name: Cheap Filter Mode
Fields.Description: On: the blur filter is limited to its cheaper mode instead of the full reconstruction filter. Retail: on for Off and Low.

Fields.Name: Sample Count Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the blur sample count; the result is clamped to 2–32 and rounded down to an even number. Retail: -2 Low and Medium, 0 High, 2 Maximum.

Fields.Name: Blur Pass Count Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the number of recursive blur passes; the result is clamped to 1–4. Retail: -1 Low, 0 Medium and High, 1 Maximum.

Fields.Name: Maximum Blur Length Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the maximum blur length. Retail: 0.5 Low, 0.75 Medium, 1 High and Maximum.
